AUTHOR: Soom, J; Pattanaik, V; Leier, M; Tuhtan, JA
TITLE: Environmentally adaptive fish or no-fish classification for river video fish counters using high-performance desktop and embedded hardware
REGION: European rivers (Germany: Mosel/Koblenz, Malliss; anonymous lowland/midland/alpine sites)
SPECIES: Fish vs no-fish videos; 17 freshwater species present (e.g., barbel, brown trout, Atlantic salmon, grayling, nase)
DATA: Own/partner footage: 3000 videos from seven Vaki River Watcher fishway counter sites
V_EV: Sec. 2.2 / Table 5: 'A balanced dataset including six different environmental conditions: clear, low lighting, air bubbles, biofilm growth, turbidity and overexposure'; Table 5 'Results of individual conditions tested with frame difference and scanlines.'
D2: 1500 videos train/test (frames 80/20 repeated random sub-sampling) vs 1500 held-out validation videos; final test 5 x 500 randomly selected videos
D_EV: Sec. 2.4.1: 'the collection of 3000 videos was split into two balanced datasets'; 'the validation videos were held-out from training and thus contained videos that the models had not encountered before.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'The 3000 videos used in this work have been collected from seven European River Watcher monitoring sites' - all training and testing drawn from this single collection.
C_EV: Table 3 lists per-condition thresholds; Sec. 2.7: 'The threshold values for each environmental condition were retrieved using Design of Experiments (DOE).'
E_EV: Sec. 2.8: 'performance of the fish / no-fish binary classification methods was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall sensitivity, recall specificity, and the F1 Score.'
ARCH: Custom 12-layer VGG-style CNN for environmental condition classification + CLAHE/Gaussian preprocessing + frame differencing / scanline motion detection + rule-based binary video classifier
METR: Accuracy, precision, recall sensitivity/specificity, F1, frames processed per second, frames per watt
NOTE: Eligibility borderline: fish/no-fish decision itself is classical CV (frame differencing/scanlines with thresholds); ML (CNN) only classifies environmental condition that adapts the fish detector. Coded INCL=Y as an AI pipeline on fishway counter field video; verifier should check criterion (a). Thresholds are motion/pixel thresholds tuned per environmental condition (DOE), not detector confidence scores - C1/C_ALL=P interpreted on that basis. Split: env-CNN trained on frames from 1500 videos, validated on other 1500 videos; unclear whether DOE threshold tuning used the same videos as final test. FN counts/percentages reported but not a dedicated FNR; E4 coded 없음.
